The '''''Galaaron''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
In c. [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the ''Galaaron'' discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durace]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] landed on the planet for a short time, while its crew gathered supplies and made repairs. Before it left, the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] made a short entry in his log about his time on Durace, noting how the crew had enjoyed being able to spend a few hours outside of the ''Galaaron''.

While Durace had seemed pleasant enough to the crew of the ''Galaaron'', at some point after their visit, the world was devastated by a large-scale disaster. A legend claimed that it was the ''Galaaron'' that had caused the disaster and that, as a result, its crew had been cursed and forced to remain on the cruiser for thousands of years. In [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] versions of the legend, the cause of the curse was attributed to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
